blocks.prompt: 14 First three of the four numbers \(a, b, c, d\) are in A.P., and the next three are in H.P., show that \(ad = bc\).
blocks.explanation:
Chaar numbers hain: pehle teen \(a, b, c\) A.P. mein aur aakhri teen \(b, c, d\) H.P. mein. Dono shartein ek ek equation dengi.
Saabit karna hai \(ad = bc\).
Plan: A.P. se \(2b = a + c\), H.P. se \(c = \frac{2bd}{b + d}\); phir doosri equation mein \(2b\) ki jagah \(a + c\) rakh kar \(b\) wali mushkil khatam karenge.
steps:
Diya gaya hai: \(a, b, c\) A.P. mein; \(b, c, d\) H.P. mein.
Saabit karna hai: \(ad = bc\).
Tareeqa: A.P. ki teen terms mein darmiyani term dono ki A.M. hoti hai, aur H.P. ki teen terms mein darmiyani term dono ki H.M. Yahi do equations kaafi hain.

A.P. wali shart
\[2b = a + c\]
Kyun: \(b\) darmiyan mein hai, to \(b = \frac{a + c}{2}\), yani \(2b = a + c\).

H.P. wali shart
\[c = \dfrac{2bd}{b + d}\]
\[c(b + d) = 2bd\]
Kyun: \(b, c, d\) mein \(c\) darmiyan mein hai, to \(c\) H.M. hai \(b\) aur \(d\) ka. Phir cross-multiply.
Dhyan dein: H.P. mein darmiyani term \(b\) nahi, \(c\) hai; terms ki tarteeb dhyan se parhein.

\(2b\) ki jagah \(a + c\) rakhein
\[c(b + d) = (a + c)d\]
\[bc + cd = ad + cd\]
Kyun: \(2bd\) ko \((2b) \times d\) samjhein; aur \(2b = a + c\) hum A.P. se jaante hain. Dono equations ko jorne ka yahi pul (bridge) hai.

\(cd\) kaat dein
\[bc = ad\]
Kyun: \(cd\) dono taraf hai, dono taraf se minus kar diya. Jo bacha wahi saabit karna tha.

Tasdeeq numbers se: \(a = 1, b = 2, c = 3\) lein (A.P.). Ab \(2, 3, d\) H.P. hon to reciprocals \(\frac{1}{2}, \frac{1}{3}, \frac{1}{d}\) A.P. mein: \(\frac{1}{d} = \frac{2}{3} - \frac{1}{2} = \frac{1}{6}\), yani \(d = 6\). Phir \(ad = 6\) aur \(bc = 6\) \(\checkmark\).
